automatico.description: Flujo único con routing inteligente de OmniRoute
directives: Classify every new task before acting; announce classification in one line
Select the smallest safe workflow automatically; do not ask the user to choose a mode
Escalate analysis depth when architecture, security, data migration or broad impact is detected
Use the knowledge vault only for relevant bounded retrieval
Use OmniRoute MCP read-only diagnostics when routing, health, quota or cost evidence is needed
For bounded research or a second opinion, use omniroute_route_request with combo free-auxiliary
Never delegate filesystem mutations or final verification to the auxiliary combo
Do not use OmniRoute mutation/configuration/plugin tools without explicit user approval
Work in the current repository only unless an additional directory is explicitly listed
Prefer small reversible changes
Close with applicable lint, typecheck and tests
Diagnose the root cause before editing
Keep the patch minimal
Add or run a regression test when available
Do not implement until scope, constraints and tradeoffs are explicit
Record accepted architecture decisions in Engram and project knowledge center
Use SDD for medium or large changes
Ground statements in repository evidence or cited sources
Preserve exact paths, commands and validation status
Do not claim runtime validation when only static inspection was performed
Map the system before proposing changes
Separate confirmed evidence from hypotheses
Use bounded exploration; avoid reading entire vaults or repositories without need

seguridad.description: Revisión de seguridad, OSINT y supply chain
directives: Use only passive reconnaissance and authorized targets
Separate confirmed vulnerabilities from hypotheses with confidence level
Prioritize: verified_secret > critical_vuln > high_reachable > medium
Do not suppress Sonar rules without documented justification
Record all findings in .ai-workflow/evidence/security/ with source, date and confidence
Do not perform critical writes
Treat model output as untrusted until verified
Escalate to a validated agent combo when tools or exactness are required
